reviews.text: We have been working with Merwin and his crew for several years, first at our townhouse and now at our new home, for all our landscaping needs. Recently, he added some amazing raised beds for our outdoor garden and was gracious enough to plant a few fruit trees for us. We absolutely love how everything turned out, and would highly recommend his services to anyone looking for a skilled lanscaper.
reviews.author: Lorraine N.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Escobar landscaping. Merwin was extremely responsive and came out to do a job within a couple days of me calling. His crew cleared some difficult and very overgrown areas of our property and did it efficiently and at an affordable price. I will be using his services again in the future.
reviews.author: Clayton Marshall

reviews.text: Marwine's Landscaping has kept my lawn and bushes perfectly for over 12 years. He is a warm friendly professional who will do whatever it takes to complete the job to your satisfaction. I highly recommend him and his team.
reviews.author: Ruth Solomon

reviews.text: Marwin and team did another great job setting up two more raised beds using hugelkultur as they did last year. Everything is ready for planting. Escobar landscaping continues to be my landscaper of choice.
reviews.author: M N.
